text: 🇲🇽🏭 On Toyota: “Trump himself attributes it to his tariffs” "It is not from the annual reviews. Trump himself attributes this decision to the tariffs he imposed on Mexico. What Toyota tells us is that it's part of its global review. And our job is to guarantee jobs and keep the investment coming." — President Claudia Sheinbaum — on Toyota and tariffs Toyota will gradually shift part of its Tacoma production from Tijuana to the US in a process ending in 2030. It keeps its Guanajuato plant (2,800 direct jobs), and Economy confirmed a new auto investment of over $500 million to be announced soon.

🔥🇲🇽 “Who polarizes? Those who spread fake news to sway opinion through lies” "Who polarizes? Those who spread fake news seek to sway opinion through lies — what greater polarization than that?" — President Claudia Sheinbaum — on disinformation Right-wing accounts pushed a false claim that Ecuador's team had been 'threatened by a criminal group' before Mexico beat them at the World Cup; Ecuador itself denied it. Sheinbaum: differences of opinion are democracy — lies are the polarization. She noted the same figures now weaponize the national team against AMLO.

🇲🇽🔍 Sinaloa security report: 2,540 arrests, 5,900 firearms, 2,412 meth labs dismantled "Under President Claudia Sheinbaum's administration, in the state of Sinaloa alone, 2,540 people have been arrested for high-impact crimes." — Security Secretary Omar García Harfuch — Sinaloa report García Harfuch reported the National Security Strategy in Sinaloa: 16,440 troops deployed; 2,540 arrests; over 94.5 tons of drugs and 5,900 firearms seized (about 20% of all weapons seized nationwide this term); and 2,412 clandestine meth labs dismantled. Daily homicide victims are down 44% since June 2025.

🇲🇽🌎 Mexico's four principles for the US relationship: cooperation without subordination "Respect for sovereignty and territorial integrity. Shared and differentiated responsibility. Mutual respect and trust. Cooperation without subordination." — President Claudia Sheinbaum — the four principles Sheinbaum laid out the four principles that govern the Mexico-US security relationship — and warned they cannot be violated. 'You cannot lie to the government of Mexico. Just as we do not lie to the US government, there must be no falsehoods from them toward us.'

🔥🇲🇽 “If there was a deal with the Sinaloa Cartel, it was under Fox and Calderón” "If there was a relationship with this criminal group, with the Sinaloa Cartel, it was under Fox and Calderón, and I say it plainly. And it is proven by the arrest of García Luna." — President Claudia Sheinbaum — answering the opposition The opposition accused the 4T of 'defending a criminal.' Sheinbaum flipped it: the cartel's leader escaped prison in 2001 under Fox and wasn't recaptured until 2014; Calderón's own security chief, Genaro García Luna, is jailed in the US for aiding the cartel. The 4T, she said, has never made pacts with criminals.

🇲🇽🌎 “We respond with dignity, because we represent a dignified people” "Mexico does not feel pressured by the United States. The US can exert pressure on us; the question is how we respond, and we respond with dignity, because we represent the people of Mexico, a dignified people." — President Claudia Sheinbaum — on US pressure Asked whether Mexico should stop feeling pressured by Washington, Sheinbaum reframed it: pressure is Washington's to apply; the response is Mexico's to choose.

🚨🇲🇽 “Who lied? Did Ambassador Ken Salazar lie?” "Who is lying? Who lied? Did Ambassador Ken Salazar lie?" — President Claudia Sheinbaum — on the FBI and El Mayo A Pie de Nota report revealed the FBI displaying, in a war-plane museum, the aircraft used to take El Mayo Zambada to the US in 2024 — crediting the operation to itself. In 2024 then-Ambassador Ken Salazar publicly told Mexico no US agency was involved. If confirmed, Sheinbaum said, it violates the UN Charter, the OAS Charter, Mexico's Constitution and the National Security Law. She recalled Lincoln: you cannot fool all the people all the time.

🇲🇽🌎 <u>US TRADE DEFICIT EXPLODES 42% — THEN WASHINGTON BLAMES MEXICO</u>

The US trade deficit exploded 42.2% in May to $77.6bn — imports up, exports down. Washington's deficit with Mexico hit a record $196.9 billion in 2025, and Trump's team uses that number to refuse T-MEC's automatic renewal and force annual reviews. Americans buy more than they sell, then blame the country that sells to them.

🚨🇲🇽 <u>KEN SALAZAR MONETIZES INNUENDO AGAINST AMLO</u>

Former US ambassador Ken Salazar's memoir, out July 28, claims AMLO "feared what El Mayo could tell the US" — sourced entirely to an unnamed "businessman friend," with zero public evidence. Sheinbaum rejected the story flat from the mañanera. The same envoy she says misled the public on El Mayo's capture is now monetizing innuendo.
